title: Office Olympics
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Office Olympics,' the office staff engages in various activities including the Office Olympics game Flonkerton, while Michael pursues his goal of becoming a homeowner, signing a mortgage, and discussing his plans for the condo. Dwight offers to be involved in Michael's property transactions, leading to some disagreements. The episode also features humorous interactions about home upgrades, team dynamics, and office competitions.

main_threads.thread: Michael's pursuit of homeownership and related activities

evidence.snippet: Michael: Today, I, Michael Scott, am becoming a homeowner. Investing in real estate.
Michael: This, my friends, is the master bedroom. Check out the cathedral ceilings.
I am going to totally pimp this place out. I am going to put a surround sound system. I am going to put a plasma screen right against this wall.
Dwight: No, no, no, no, no. This is a shared wall. Neighbor throws his wife into the wall, plasma screen hits the floor. Totally smashed.
Dwight: Warrantees don't cover it, plus they're a rip-off.
Michael: No, no, no.
Jim (sings Olympic theme song): This scented candle …andle …andle.
Pam: Jim, they refer to it as Flonkerton.
Jim: Yes! Phyllis! Phyllis, just put your foot right through here . Right through the flonk.
Phyllis: I'll do it.
Dwight: A thirty year mortgage at Michael's age essentially means that he's buying a coffin. If I were buying my coffin, I would get one with thicker walls so you couldn't hear ...
Jim: So, who will be challenging Kevin in Flonkerton? Anyone?
